policy: Readiness is evidence-based. A division cannot be marked standby or operational solely because a plan or repository exists.

checks.name: Responsible owner and escalation route defined
Relevant automated and manual tests passed
Failure, recovery, and rollback procedures tested
Secrets, permissions, and data-handling review completed
Owner approval gates and prohibited actions enforced
Monitoring, reporting, and audit evidence available

evidence: Initial organisation charter and division registry added on a development branch.
Organisation Control Centre validator, dashboard builders, dependency report, work queue, incident, recovery, security and governance checks passed GitHub Actions run 43343966117.
open_gaps: Control Centre remains a draft feature branch; no merge, deployment or persistent live dashboard.
Division owners and escalation contacts need formal confirmation.
Several divisions still lack independently verified operating evidence.

evidence: Repository contains opportunity intelligence, division intake, engineering triage, deterministic risk review, finance/payout due diligence and executive reporting agents.
All AI Revenue workflow tests, Canadian employer ATS candidate validation, read-only feed collection, intake, triage, risk, finance and executive report steps passed run 43473069742.
open_gaps: Opportunity eligibility, platform terms, payout mechanics and individual leads still require source-level human verification.
No verified customer revenue recorded.
No approved customer acquisition, application, outreach or delivery workflow yet.

evidence: Repository README explicitly defines paper-trading-only scope.
Paper position lifecycle includes atomic partial exits, versioned stop/trailing/take-profit decisions, FIFO P&L reconciliation, persistent drawdown and allow-listed PAPER_ONLY state persistence.
All 135 then-current paper-engine tests and synthetic simulation passed run 43473656375.
Read-only Forex and Indices context specialists and their synthetic tests passed the 153-test suite in run 43474468908; specialist and position-engine scope is documented on a draft branch.
open_gaps: Position and exit-engine work remains on unmerged draft branches; no live capability is approved.
Independent Risk review of the position lifecycle, drawdown controls, ledger and recovery assumptions remains outstanding.
Current specialist modules consume caller-supplied synthetic/test data; permitted production data sources, provenance, licensing, freshness and outage handling are not yet integrated.
Forex and Indices are analysis-only foundations, not completed source-connected specialist services.
No durable hosted paper service, continuous monitoring, alerting or independently tested production recovery environment.
Historical/out-of-sample evaluation with realistic network fees, liquidity and slippage assumptions remains incomplete.
No live-trading readiness claim is permitted.

evidence: Read-only listing CSV audit MVP exists.
open_gaps: Ecommerce is an active rebuild workstream; existing storefront/listing baseline and product economics require a current read-only audit.
No verified sales, unit economics, fulfilment quality or customer-acquisition economics are established.
No listings, purchases, publishing, paid promotion or account changes are authorized.

evidence: Long-term studio ambition recorded in strategic planning.
open_gaps: Animora is an active development workstream; current site functionality, content pipeline and monetisation paths require a fresh audit.
Original characters and brand assets must be preserved; Lovable credits and paid tools remain off limits until explicitly authorized.
No public changes, publishing, paid production or launch is authorized.

evidence: A distinct TISRD charter and Ontario-first source qualification policy are documented in Solana-memecoins PR #39 (draft and unmerged).
The charter defines authorized replication and information-only research paths, a paper lifecycle, independent risk challenge, and no-execution boundaries.
open_gaps: The charter is documentation-only; no production workflow, source-permission registry, connector, or strategy observation store is verified.
Platform-by-platform rights, Ontario eligibility, retention, automation and copy-trading permissions remain unverified or restricted; no unauthorized trader profiling or scraping is permitted.
No reproducible paper-replication dataset, isolated strategy ledger, out-of-sample results, or benchmark evidence is established.
Named accountable owner, escalation route, monitoring, and cross-division rehearsal evidence remain outstanding.
No platform application, paid feed, wallet connection, or live execution is authorized.

evidence: Control Centre draft includes security-posture, readiness, dependency, work-queue, execution-log and incident validators plus isolated fixture recovery checks; latest workflow confirms these validation steps passed before the test stage.
Crypto development branches contain read-only Solana RPC, provider failover and paper-ingestion components with synthetic test coverage.
open_gaps: No approved hosted runtime, persistent monitoring, alert routing or independently tested production failover is established.
Live RPC/provider connectivity, endpoint independence, credential governance and sustained outage/restart behaviour remain unverified.
Control Centre and Crypto changes remain draft/unmerged; no production deployment or permission changes are authorized.

evidence: Research and source-qualification mandates are documented in the Control Centre framework and TISRD charter PR #39.
Official source reviews have identified explicit data-rights and Ontario constraints for Pump.fun, Polymarket, Kalshi and other candidate sources.
open_gaps: No unified, operational source-permission register with accountable review ownership is implemented.
Several platform permissions, data retention rights, Ontario eligibility and automated-use rights remain restricted, unclear or unverified.
No continuously refreshed research service or independently rehearsed handoff to every division is established.

evidence: The Control Centre records CAD 0 as the default operating budget and reserves financial transactions, borrowing and paid commitments for explicit owner approval.
Crypto PR #37 documents a paper-only CAD ledger and fee-inclusive FIFO accounting/reconciliation prototype.

Draft PR #6 adds a CAD 0 financial-control policy, empty commitment register, proof/approval/currency controls, cash-receipt classification and halal-sensitive activity flags; tests are included but have not been executed.
open_gaps: No live revenue or commitment entries have been reconciled; the current registers are empty and do not establish activity or balances outside the records.
No bank/payment account connection, independently verified cash balance, bank reconciliation, tax export or reserve execution workflow exists.
No named finance owner or active approval ledger is established; all positive spending remains blocked by the CAD 0 ceiling.
Halal screening is informational only; uncertain financing, investment, yield or trading structures require qualified review and no automated religious ruling is made.
Offline finance tests and dashboard integration remain unexecuted; operational readiness is not established.

evidence: The Control Centre draft contains risk, incident, security and recovery records plus validators and a temporary-fixture recovery drill.
Crypto PR #37 contains a recovery charter and local SQLite case-register prototype with synthetic tests.
open_gaps: No active incident cases are recorded; the repository drill validates temporary fixtures only, not production recovery.
No production case-register RBAC, encryption, tamper-evident evidence export, authenticated case ownership or tested alert/deadline workflow is established.
Independent named risk/recovery ownership, cross-division incident rehearsals and production containment/recovery evidence remain outstanding.

evidence: A distinct Business & Commercial division, support scope and approval boundary are now recorded in the Control Centre operating framework.
open_gaps: No verified customer pipeline, commercial operating workflow, named owner or escalation route is established.
No approved client outreach, proposal submission, contract, customer delivery or revenue-recognition workflow is active.
Market demand, pricing, fulfilment capacity, contract terms and customer-acquisition costs require source-backed validation before any commercial commitment.
